pairs.registryProposal: candidate-write-access does not cover the case where the instrument structurally cannot witness the property (here, a craft rung on an already-green dimension where the rubric has no headroom), leaving the candidate's own claim as the only available signal. The technique could say what replaces the missing witness (a second instrument, a sampled human read, or declaring the count as claimed-not-measured) rather than leaving implementers to accept the claim.
